Update: The all-new HomeView smart display, next-generation Apple TV 4K, and HomePod mini 2 are now available for pre-order.

Just after the reveal of Apple’s new 2026 home collection gear, we are still tracking AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, AirPods Max 2 with $120 in savings, and there’s still time to land the mid-range M6 Mac mini at nearly $150 off. Those deals are joining some brilliant M5 Pro MacBook Pro discounts this week with as much as $600 off the list prices (there are a pair of configurations that are actually $200 less than the pre-price hike MSRPs right now). On top of that, the $199 clearance deal on this Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 is back, we have Anker’s new Nano Neo 45W/60W dynamic charger for your iPhone 18 Pro at just $20, and a whole lot more waiting below, including the iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil (USB-C).

Apple’s all-new HomeView smart display, HomePod mini 2, and Apple TV 4K now available for pre-order

  • Apple HomeView $299
  • Silver, Rose Pink, Starlight, Space Gray
  • Apple HomeView (Wall mounted) $299
  • HomePod mini 2 $149

AirPods Pro 3 currently $50 off at Amazon, AirPods Max 2 $120 off

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (Reg. $549)

These M5 Pro MacBook Pro models are $200 under the pre-price hike rate (Up to $600 off)

While we are fresh off the new fall Prime Day sale, and much of the MacBook deals have disappeared, Amazon actually kicked the week off with a pair of particularly notable MacBook Pro deals. This 2TB 14-inch is $600 off and we have a seriously rare $500 price drop on this 16-inch 24GB model.

While the MacBook Pro lineup got significantly more expensive back in late June with the official Apple price hikes, these two deals are solid offers even by pre-price hike standards:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,399 (Reg. $2,999)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro M5 Pro 24GB/1TB $2,499 (Reg. $2,999)

You’re looking at up to $600 off the new list prices and a pair of the best MacBook deals we have tracked in months.

But perhaps more importantly is the comparison to the previous list prices. Both of these configurations are currently $200 under the pre-price hike MSRPs. All things considered, these would be solid deals even before Apple jacked the prices up and that’s not something you can say very often with these storage and memory-laden tech.

There’s, of course, no telling how long these deals might last, but if you are in the market for a Pro upgrade these better-than-Prime day prices might be worth serious consideration.

Don’t pay full price for iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil (USB-C), Amazon has it for less

Clearance deal on Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop live again at $199 off

Update 10/13: This deal is now live once again at Amazon.

While we did catch some notable $99 drops on select Apple Watch Ultra 4 models during Prime Day, stock was extremely limited and the deals continually disappeared on us. That said, the now previous-gen Ultra 3 is still a wonderful option if you can land it at the $200 off clearance price Amazon has up for grabs right now.

Amazon is currently offering the Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the matching Milanese Loop down at $699.97 shipped.

That’s still a pricey Apple Watch, but this was a regularly $899 config with the gorgeous black Milanese Loop that is now back down to one of the lowest prices we have tracked.

It did fall lower for a couple hours during Prime Day, but almost no one had a chance to score that deal. Outside of that this is on par with the lowest we have seen and well below the $749 low we tracked before the Ultra 4 arrived.

Considering the Ultra 4 had to release before we ever saw this model hit that $199 off range, chances are it will be the better part of a year before we see that sort of deal on the new model. We might catch something better than the $100 off we had for Prime Day come Black Friday next month, but it’s hard to say for sure – this model was $100 off Black Friday last year, for the record.

You can still score Apple’s mid-range M6 Mac mini at nearly $150 off if you’re quick

While AirPods Pro 3 are now at $50 off, AirPods Max 2 are still at the Prime Day price with $120 in savings and this mid-range 512GB M6 Mac mini is the last of Apple’s brand new machines still at the nearly $150 off mark.

Amazon is still offering Apple’s brand new M6 Mac mini with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB SSD down at $949.99 shipped.

This is a regularly $1,099 machine sitting at $149 off to land within $1 of the lowest price we have tracked to date online.

It dropped to $150 off for fall Prime Day, which was the very first particularly notable discount. And while many of the configs have started to jump up in price now, this one is still very close to the lowest price we have tracked to date and among the most notable Apple Prime Day deals we tracked for this year’s fall sale event.

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (Reg. $899) – Within $11 of all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (Reg. $1,099) – Within $1
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,150 (Reg. $1,299)– All-time low
  • 2026 M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,599 (Reg. $1,699) – Within $50
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio $2,299 (Reg. $2,499) – All-time low

It is most likely only a matter of time before this deal is gone for good, much like some of the other Apple gear we are tracking on sale early this week:

Apple’s 2026 Mac Studio still $200 off (Amazon all-time low), Mac mini up to $150 off

Alongside some hangover all-time lows on the new Mac mini lineup (they are starting to disappear quickly), Amazon is also still holding on to the best price we have tracked online for the brand new 2026 Mac Studio at $200 off.

Amazon is currently offering the most affordable 2026 Mac Studio down at $2,299 shipped.

Regularly $2,499, this is an M5 Max-powered machine with 36GB of RAM, 512GB of storage, an 18-core CPU, and 32-core GPU ready to upgrade your at-home local AI rig, Final Cut editing bay, or Logic Pro setup with some serious power.

Now $200 off, this is $1 under the price of the initial Prime Day deal to land at the lowest price we have tracked anywhere online. As mentioned previously, there have even some limited in-store only offers at local authorized dealers for less, but this is the best deal anyone can take advantage of online.
